title: Look up a Provider
shortDescription: Look up a Provider enables you to find information about a single provider.
body:
## Look up a Provider

Look up a Provider enables you to find information about a single provider. 

Criteria

Required Field

Name/ID

To find a provider you need to enter at least one of the following pieces of information without using any wildcard symbols:  

•	last name only, 

•	first and last (separated by a space or comma), 

•	facility name, 

•	   Zelis ID,

•	ClientID  , or 

•	NPI.  



Optional Fields

The having specialties  and within fields are optional.  By using these, you can filter your results.   



Having Specialties

Select your desired provider type(s) or specialty group(s).



Within

Enter your desired geography.  You can enter cities, counties, MSAs, state abbreviation, population file, or zip codes (3-digit or 5-digit codes).  

•	Entering partial zip codes or free form text will not yield any results.  

•	Using the Create a population file, it enables you to create a new file to be used in your search.   

•	When you enter multiple geographies, Network360 uses “or” logic, so if you enter 'Johnson County, KS' and 'Topeka, KS MSA' you will see providers that reside in either geography.



For more details on Bulk Search, see Bulk Search help content.

For more details on creating a Population File, see Population File help content.





 

Results 

After you enter your search criteria and click **Go**, you will see a list of providers    who match or closely match (visually or phonetically) your search parameters.  The results automatically include spelling variations and names that sound similar.  

•	Names that most closely match are sorted to the top of the list. 



•	You may see addresses that don’t match the search criteria. 



For example, if any part of a provider’s address matches the search criteria, the provider will be included in the results part of the address



•	You may see results where no part of the address   matches the selected geography. 



For example, if the search is for a city that shares a zip with another city, then a provider from a different city with the same zip code will display. 



You will see the provider locations that are outside of the geography if the provider practices at multiple locations. If one of the locations matches the zip of the geography, it will display all the locations in which the provider practices.



To see more details about an individual provider, click the provider’s name. The Provider Profile page appears. 



For more details on the Provider Profile page, see Provider Profile help content.



 



Exporting the Provider Details List

The Provider Details List can be exported as a .csv file. To export, click the Export button. As with exporting the Provider Details List,  a message will display to let you know the export process has begun and once the Export is ready to be downloaded an additional message will be displayed with a summary of your search criteria and a link to Download results, as shown in the screenshot below.

 

If you click the dropdown arrow within the Export button, you can select which columns you want to include in your export, such as Networks (when you choose networks you can then select either summary or specialty details), Tags, Provider Comments, and/or Custom Attributes (if applicable).

When you select Networks with Summary, your export will include a Network column for each provider-location in the Detail Results and the specialty will be the best match from all the networks.

When you select Networks with Specialty Details, your export will include all provider-location-specialty combinations, rather than only the best match specialty.

When you select Networks with either Summary or Specialty Details, Par Indicator (Participating Indicator) codes are included in the Network column(s) for each provider-location-specialty combination in the export file.
